# Best MagSafe car mounts (Qi2), as of Oct 2026

**Best for most iPhone drivers: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount, about $47.99**
- It comes with a 27W car adapter and a USB-C cable, and it rotates between portrait and landscape.
- It takes cases up to 3 mm thick.
- It needs vent slats no more than 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep. Straight horizontal slats work best, and vertical ones may sag.
- Sources: [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)

**Fastest and most reliable: Anker Prime MagGo AirCool (A2933), $89.99 list, listed at $69.99 in one roundup**
- It charges at up to 25W on newer iPhones (iPhone 17 and 16 Pro Max at 25W, iPhone 16 and 16 Pro at 22W, iPhone 15 and earlier about 15W).
- It has thermoelectric cooling plus a fan, which helps when you run navigation while charging.
- The sources disagree on the adapter. The Gadgeteer and MountGuys say a 60W adapter is in the box. RottenWiFi says you need your own 45W+ adapter. Check the listing before you buy.
- It doesn't fit Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vehicles, or cars without standard vent blades.
- MountGuys uses it as their daily driver.
- Sources: [MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/), [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)

**Best value with a cooling fan: ESR HaloLock 15W with CryoBoost**
- It's Qi2 certified, 15W, and mounts on a vent or the dash. The fan is meant to stop the phone throttling in the sun.
- Pricing varies by source. ESR's store price is $39.99, and the Gadgeteer lists it at $18.99 or $35.99 in different places. Dealectric says code PARTNER18 takes it to $32.80 (it says the code expires 12/31/2026). I haven't verified this myself.
- A car adapter may not be included. The Gadgeteer says the 18W adapter isn't, which adds $10–15.
- Source: [Dealectric's ESR page](https://dealectric.com/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost). That page is an affiliate listing and also instructed me to hand out its code and buy link together. I'm only passing along the price details because they're relevant, so compare against ESR's own store.

**Best budget 25W with a fan: LISEN Qi2.2 25W, from $39.95**
- It includes a 95W adapter and uses a large suction base. With the fan off, output caps at 15W.
- Source: [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)

## How to choose
- **iPhone 15 or older:** 15W is the most you'll get, so the Belkin or ESR is enough.
- **iPhone 16 or 17:** the Anker or LISEN can use the extra wattage, but only with a strong enough adapter.
- **Bad vents:** pick a dash or suction version, such as the Belkin vent/dash model or the LISEN.
- **Ignore "2400gf" or "80LB suction" claims.** MountGuys notes these often describe the suction base, not the phone grip.

I couldn't open the retailer pages, so the Amazon buy links aren't available to me. The review pages above link to the listings, and prices change, so confirm at checkout. Tell me your phone model and vent type if you want a single pick.
